data.title: Generali Thailand and Krungsri Auto Broker Extend Strategic Partnership for Five Years
data.description: Generali Life Assurance (Thailand) has joined forces with Krungsri Auto Broker, an insurance brokerage service provider under Ayudhya Capital Auto Lease Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Bank of Ayudhya Public Company Limited, to renew their strategic partnership for another five years. , The partnership will continue to develop life protection solutions for auto loan customers while expanding protection options that meet consumers' needs, enhancing financial security and providing peace of mind throughout the loan term.

data.title: Dutch say won't participate in 'no longer' neutral Eurovision
data.description: THE HAGUE - The Netherlands will not participate in next year's Eurovision Song Contest, its broadcaster said Monday, saying the event can "no longer be considered neutral" given divisions over the Gaza war.

data.title: Beyond the Magnificent Seven: The Next Wave of AI Investment
data.description: The first phase of the artificial intelligence (AI) investment story belonged to a handful of remarkable companies. Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, Meta and Tesla, the so-called Magnificent Seven, sit at the centre of the most important technology shift in a generation, and the market has rewarded them for it. They now account for roughly a third of the S&P 500, and in 2025 they produced about 42% of the index's total return1. Buy a plain US index fund today and nearly 40 cents of every dollar goes into just 10 companies.
